caption_L1: This bar graph is labeled Foreign-born population in Sweden in 2019 , by region of birth. Along the y-axis, Country is plotted with a categorical scale starting at Africa and ending at Unknown. Number of inhabitants is shown on the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: The chart shows that inhabitants from Asia are by far the largest group of foreign born inhabitants in Sweden. There are only very small numbers of foreign born inhabitants from the former USSR & Oceania and no unknown foreign born inhabitants.
